sobre.texto: Every work here is in the public domain and was translated by Alcy Filho with the help of artificial intelligence. The translations are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0: you may read, download, copy and adapt them, as long as you give credit and share under the same license. Reading needs no account; with an Ekfrase account, the book goes to your inventory and the reader keeps your place and your notes.
